🎖️ NCC Rank & Award Ceremony

Vidyashilp Academy celebrated the dedication, discipline, and achievements of our young NCC cadets at the Rank & Award Ceremony for the 2025–2027 batch.

🚀 The Startup Weekend: Bengaluru Edition 💡

What if one idea could become the beginning of a real startup?

In collaboration with Masters’ Union, Vidyashilp Academy brought together students from Grades 8–12 for an immersive weekend of entrepreneurship, innovation, and real-world problem-solving.

From ideating business solutions and building MVPs to exploring financial fundamentals, AI tools, storytelling, and investor pitch decks, our young innovators transformed their ideas into actionable ventures with guidance from experienced mentors.

It was a weekend of bold ideas, hands-on learning, and entrepreneurial thinking! 🌟

#proudmoment #thevidyashilpway #futureready #studentsuccess #futureready

📈💰 **MOCKSTOCK 2026 — BRINGING THE STOCK MARKET TO LIFE!**

What happens when students step into the world of stock trading? **Strategy, decision-making, teamwork, and a whole lot of excitement!**

The **Intermediate Round** gave our students a hands-on experience of conventional stock trading, with bankers issuing currency, brokerage firms issuing shares, and registrars facilitating the buying and selling of shares on behalf of the investing teams.

The **Final Round** took the challenge online, where teams were given **₹10 lakh in virtual cash** and just **2 hours** to navigate a simulated stock market. The team that generated the **highest profit** emerged as the winners! 🏆📊

An immersive experience that transformed financial concepts into real-world learning and put our students’ market knowledge to the test.

#TheVidyashilpWay #MockStock2026 #FinancialLiteracy #ExperientialLearning #VidyashilpAcademy

🌟 Steps for Smiles – Season 3 🌟

Every step can create a reason to smile. 💛

Vidyashilp Academy is proud to present “Steps for Smiles – Season 3,” a student-led Walkathon/Marathon in collaboration with Cytecare Cancer Hospital, Bengaluru, dedicated to supporting paediatric cancer care.

Since its inception in 2017–18, the VSA Cancer Care Fund has supported the treatment of children battling cancer and helped bring hope to the lives of 60 children. With the overwhelming support of our community, the last two editions raised over ₹10 lakh towards this meaningful cause.

This year, with an anticipated participation of 2,000 people, we come together once again to turn every step into hope, compassion, and smiles. 💫
